caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate pink perfume bottle or decanter set against a plain light beige background. The bottle has a rounded, bulbous stopper at the top, painted in shades of pink and white with a small dark top, leading down to a slender neck that flares out twice with two horizontal ridges. The main body of the bottle is wider at the base and tapers toward the neck. Around the widest part of the bottle, there is a horizontal gold band with small embellishments. The surface of the bottle is decorated with a floral design featuring brown-green leaves and blue and white flowers with hints of reddish shading. The bottle is highlighted with gradients of pink, suggesting a glass or porcelain material. At the bottom right of the drawing, there is a small, handwritten signature in pink that reads “MOSS.”
title: Toilet Bottle
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
